cards.back: A round flat shape with 1 curved side and no corners. A coin is a circle.
cards.say: Circle. A round flat shape with one curved side and no corners. A coin is a circle.

cards.back: A flat shape with 3 straight sides and 3 corners.
cards.say: Triangle. A flat shape with three straight sides and three corners.

cards.back: A flat shape with 4 straight sides that are all the same length, and 4 corners.
cards.say: Square. A flat shape with four straight sides that are all the same length, and four corners.

cards.back: A flat shape with 4 straight sides and 4 corners. It has 2 long sides and 2 short sides.
cards.say: Rectangle. A flat shape with four straight sides and four corners. It has two long sides and two short sides.

cards.back: A flat shape with 5 straight sides and 5 corners.
cards.say: Pentagon. A flat shape with five straight sides and five corners.

cards.back: A flat shape with 6 straight sides and 6 corners.
cards.say: Hexagon. A flat shape with six straight sides and six corners.

cards.back: A point where two sides of a shape meet.

cards.front: How many sides has a triangle?

cards.front: How many sides has a hexagon?

cards.front: How many corners has a square?

cards.front: How is a square different from a rectangle?
cards.back: A square has 4 equal sides. A rectangle has 2 long sides and 2 short sides.
